techniques.name: Blameless postmortem
techniques.goal: Turn meaningful failures into durable systemic improvements
techniques.mechanism: Document timeline, impact, contributing causes, detection/response quality, what went well/poorly, and measurable preventive/mitigating actions without person-blame.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Failure registry can auto-draft evidence/timeline; final causal claims remain reviewable.
avoid_when: Trivial isolated failure with no learning value

techniques.name: Predefined postmortem trigger policy
techniques.goal: Avoid selective learning only from dramatic failures
techniques.mechanism: Define thresholds such as user impact, data loss, security event, repeated manual intervention, long resolution, monitoring failure or recurring defect.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Include model/tool loops and repeated user corrections as triggers, not only outages.

techniques.name: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA)
techniques.goal: Separate immediate repair from actions that prevent recurrence or reduce impact
techniques.mechanism: For each incident identify correction, root/system cause, preventive design change, detection improvement and verification of action effectiveness.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every action item requires a verifiable end state.
avoid_when: No evidence a preventive action is feasible

techniques.name: Bottom-up FMEA
techniques.goal: Identify how each component/tool/state can fail and how failures propagate
techniques.mechanism: Enumerate failure modes at component/interface level, effects, severity, detection/controls and corrective provisions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Run at subsystem boundaries, not every trivial function.

techniques.name: Top-down Fault Tree Analysis
techniques.goal: Discover combinations of causes that could produce a predefined catastrophic outcome
techniques.mechanism: Start from hazard/top event and decompose logical AND/OR causal paths until actionable basic events/controls emerge.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use for 'must never happen' Agent OS invariants.
risks: Causal tree can oversimplify dynamic interactions

techniques.name: STPA / unsafe-control-action analysis
techniques.goal: Find hazards caused by interactions, timing and unsafe control even when individual components do not 'fail'
techniques.mechanism: Model controller, controlled process, feedback and constraints; enumerate missing/wrong/too-early/too-late/too-long control actions and causal scenarios.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Especially relevant because AI hazards often arise from nominal-but-wrong actions, not crashes.
avoid_when: Simple component whose hazards are fully local

techniques.name: Hazard register
techniques.goal: Keep severe failure possibilities visible through design changes
techniques.mechanism: Maintain stable hazard IDs, causes, affected assets, severity, controls, verification, residual risk, owner/review date.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Link hazards to eval cases, authorization rules and incidents.

techniques.name: Near-miss capture
techniques.goal: Learn from failures caught before user harm
techniques.mechanism: Record events where validator, reviewer, approval, sandbox or user correction stopped an unsafe/wrong action; analyze repeated near-miss patterns.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Near misses are evidence about both upstream failure and downstream control effectiveness.
risks: High volume/noise if every rejected candidate counted

techniques.name: Barrier/control effectiveness tracking
techniques.goal: Measure whether each protective layer actually catches relevant failure modes
techniques.mechanism: For hazards map preventive/detective/mitigating barriers and record tests/incidents that exercised each one.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Avoid counting multiple correlated model prompts as independent barriers.

techniques.name: Common-cause failure analysis
techniques.goal: Detect supposedly independent checks that can fail together
techniques.mechanism: Identify shared model family, training data, prompt, retrieval source, service, dependency or code path among generator/reviewer/fallbacks.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: A 'second agent' is not independent evidence if it shares the same failure source.
risks: True dependency relationships can be hidden by providers

techniques.name: Defense-in-depth with heterogeneous controls
techniques.goal: Reduce dependence on one failure-prone control type
techniques.mechanism: Combine architectural authorization, schema validation, static checks, sandbox, external verifier, readback and human approval according to risk.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer heterogeneous barriers over repeated prompting.
avoid_when: Adding redundant controls with no independent value

techniques.name: Swiss-cheese failure-path analysis
techniques.goal: Understand how multiple imperfect defenses can align to permit a failure
techniques.mechanism: Map hazard path through layers and identify holes/conditions that must coincide; strengthen independent weak layers.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful communication layer over barrier/control registry.
avoid_when: Used as a substitute for quantitative testing

techniques.name: Five-Whys-style causal drilling
techniques.goal: Push analysis beyond proximate symptom
techniques.mechanism: Iteratively ask why an event/control was possible until reaching an actionable system/process/design condition.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use as question generator, never as proof of one true root cause.
risks: Creates a false single root cause

techniques.name: Causal graph / contributing-factor analysis
techniques.goal: Represent multi-factor incidents without forcing one root cause
techniques.mechanism: Build directed graph of necessary/enabling/triggering conditions, evidence and uncertainties; link potential interventions to nodes/edges.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Explicitly distinguish observed sequence, inferred cause and hypothesis.

techniques.name: Incident timeline reconstruction
techniques.goal: Recover what actually happened before theorizing why
techniques.mechanism: Merge logs, tool events, commits, approvals, messages and state snapshots into ordered evidence timeline with clock/source confidence.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Diagnosis starts after observable timeline is assembled.

techniques.name: Detection-gap analysis
techniques.goal: Improve how quickly future failures become visible
techniques.mechanism: Ask when failure began, when system could first have detected it, when it actually did, and what signal/rule would close the gap.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Action item may be an eval or invariant, not necessarily an alert.
risks: More monitoring can create alert fatigue

techniques.name: Mitigation-gap analysis
techniques.goal: Reduce harm duration even when prevention is impossible
techniques.mechanism: Analyze rollback, isolation, fallback, degradation, cancellation and human intervention options between detection and full repair.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Separate prevention from containment; both create backlog candidates.
risks: Fallback can have its own hidden risk

techniques.name: Positive deviance / what-went-well analysis
techniques.goal: Learn from controls/actions that unexpectedly limited impact or produced excellent outcomes
techniques.mechanism: Postmortem successful detection, fallback, reviewer, workflow or user behavior; test whether it generalizes into reusable design.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Postmortem records 'went well' as evidence for skill/control improvement.

techniques.name: Bayesian online change-point detection
techniques.goal: Detect regime shifts that rolling averages/control charts may smear
techniques.mechanism: Maintain posterior over run length/regime and signal when observations are more consistent with a new generative regime.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use after stratifying task family; a model release can deliberately reset baseline.

techniques.name: Baseline segmentation by regime/version
techniques.goal: Avoid comparing incompatible periods as if one stationary process
techniques.mechanism: Reset/annotate monitoring baselines at known model, prompt, tool, dataset, policy or workflow version changes.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Telemetry event stream marks change points intentionally.
risks: Too many segments reduce statistical power

techniques.name: Leading vs lagging indicators
techniques.goal: Detect risk before final user failure while retaining outcome truth
techniques.mechanism: Track leading signals such as retries, validator disagreement, context overflow, low retrieval coverage alongside lagging task success/corrections.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only promote a leading metric after proving correlation/predictive value.
risks: Proxy optimization can Goodhart away from actual outcome

techniques.name: Sentinel canary cases
techniques.goal: Continuously detect catastrophic regression on a tiny stable set
techniques.mechanism: Run a small set of critical known cases regularly across active model/tool/config versions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Combine immutable security sentinels with rotating functional sentinels.

techniques.name: Risk-based test depth
techniques.goal: Spend verification effort proportional to consequence and novelty
techniques.mechanism: Assign risk class from action/data/irreversibility/uncertainty; increase test, reviewer, canary and approval requirements with risk.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Authorization risk class feeds experiment/promotion policy.

techniques.name: Pre-mortem / prospective failure analysis
techniques.goal: Find likely failure modes before implementation or rollout
techniques.mechanism: Assume proposed feature failed badly; enumerate plausible causal paths, warning signs and mitigations, then convert credible items into tests/controls.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Constructive Challenge Engine runs bounded premortem on high-risk proposals.

techniques.name: Safety case / assurance argument
techniques.goal: Make explicit why a high-risk capability is believed safe enough
techniques.mechanism: Build structured claims→arguments→evidence for critical properties, with unresolved assumptions and evidence freshness.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Future model can audit claim links instead of trusting a narrative 'security review'.
risks: Can become documentation theater if evidence is weak
